dataset: Woolsey Fire 2018 incident identifiers, ignition evidence and published calibration facts
interpretation: Only numbers printed in the cited sources. Values that are bounds ('more than', 'less than', 'approximately') keep that qualifier in value_qualifier. Area-wide evacuation totals mix the Woolsey and concurrent Hill fire areas unless the source says otherwise; none of these totals is a vehicle count, departure curve or clearance time.
